units.zh: 在《联合国气候变化框架公约》第三十一次缔约方大会安塔利亚领导人峰会上的发言 （2026年11月11日，土耳其安塔利亚） 中华人民共和国副主席 韩正
units.en: Remarks by Vice President Han Zheng at the 31st Conference of the Parties to the UNFCCC Antalya Leaders' Summit Antalya, Nov. 11, 2026

units.zh: 尊敬的埃尔多安总统， 各位同事， 女士们、先生们、朋友们：
units.en: Your Excellency President Recep Tayyip Erdogan, Colleagues, Ladies and Gentlemen, Friends,

units.zh: 很高兴作为中国国家主席习近平的特别代表，出席安塔利亚领导人峰会。习近平主席指出，应对气候变化是人类共同的事业。当前，全球气候变化不利影响加速显现。面对新形势，我愿提4点建议。
units.en: It is a great pleasure to attend the Antalya Leaders' Summit as the special representative of Chinese President Xi Jinping. President Xi pointed out that climate response is a common cause for all humanity. As the adverse impacts of global climate change are emerging at a faster pace, I wish to make four proposals.

units.zh: 第一，锚定共同目标，强化集体行动。要遵循共同但有区别的责任原则，全面有效落实《联合国气候变化框架公约》及其《巴黎协定》，凝聚全球气候治理合力。发达国家应率先减排，兑现气候资金承诺。各方应全力落实国家自主贡献，力争做得更好。
units.en: First, focus on common goals and strengthen collective actions. It is important to follow the principle of common but differentiated responsibilities, fully and effectively implement the UNFCCC and its Paris Agreement, and pool synergy for global climate governance. Developed countries should take the lead in emission reduction and honor their commitment of climate finance. All parties should fully deliver on their Nationally Determined Contributions (NDCs) and strive to do better.

units.zh: 第二，加快绿色转型，推进低碳发展。要促进优质绿色技术和产品自由流通，推动经济和产业结构转型升级。中国今年规划了2030年非化石能源发电量占比达到50%、电能占终端能源消费比重达到35%等目标，坚定不移推进碳达峰碳中和。
units.en: Second, accelerate the green transition and promote low-carbon development. It is important to facilitate the free flow of quality green technology and products, and promote the transition and upgrading of economic and industrial structure. This year, China sets the goal of raising the share of non-fossil fuel energy in power generation to 50 percent, and that of electricity in final energy consumption to 35 percent by 2030. We will unswervingly advance toward carbon peaking and carbon neutrality.

units.zh: 第三，防范气候灾害，提升气候韧性。要坚持减缓和适应并重，加强防灾减灾、监测预警、灾害救援等领域合作，提高气候适应能力。中国愿推动气象智能预警方案“妈祖”在更多国家落地应用，助力各国防范和应对气候风险。
units.en: Third, prevent climate disasters and enhance climate resilience. It is important to be committed to both mitigation and adaptation, and strengthen cooperation on disaster prevention and reduction, monitoring and early warning, and rescue, so as to improve climate adaptability. China will enable more countries to use the AI-powered meteorological warning system, or MAZU, to enhance their climate resilience.

units.zh: 第四，坚持开放普惠，深化国际合作。要加强对发展中国家的支持和帮助，共建清洁美丽世界。中国持续推进非洲光带等应对气候变化南南合作项目，将推出“全球南方气候行动领袖计划”能力建设项目。中国也将为国际航空碳抵消和减排机制的公平有效实施作出贡献。
units.en: Fourth, uphold openness and inclusiveness and deepen international cooperation. It is important to offer more support and assistance to developing countries and jointly build a clean and beautiful world. China continues to promote South-South cooperation projects in response to climate change such as Africa Solar Belt, and will roll out the Global South Climate Action Leadership Program. China will make its contributions to the fair and effective implementation of the Carbon Offsetting and Reduction Scheme for International Aviation.
